greetings_help: Use a single text like "Hello". Use 4 items split by semicolons for time-based greetings: "Good morning;Good noon;Good afternoon;Good evening". Use 2, 3, or more than 4 items to show one random greeting on each refresh.

about_desc_1: SuperFlare is a lightweight self-hosted start page for personal dashboards, homelabs, NAS devices, and LAN environments, bringing apps, bookmarks, and local addresses together in one place.
about_desc_2: It includes login protection, online editing, backup and restore, port discovery, theme and background customization, automatic icon fallback, subdirectories, and a bilingual interface for long-term maintenance.
about_desc_3: This project is forked from soulteary/docker-flare and further extends the original with native Go deployment, fnOS / NAS adaptation, configuration management, and broader UX improvements.
site_icon_help: Choose an MDI icon name. Leave empty to use the default favicon. Full icon library:
custom_background_image_help: Use a remote image URL, local static path, or upload an image below. Leave empty to use the theme background.
upload_background_image_help: Uploaded images are stored locally and replace the background image path above.
home_max_columns_help: 0 uses the default. The layout automatically reduces columns when the viewport is narrower.
home_max_width_help: Unit: px. 0 uses the default width.
custom_theme_help: Accepts rgba(), rgb(), or hex colors. Saving selects the custom theme.
login_user_config_placeholder: Leave empty to use startup/env defaults
login_pass_config_placeholder: Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password
login_pass_confirm_placeholder: Enter the same password again when changing it
login_pass_confirm_error: The two login passwords do not match.
login_config_help: Leave the username empty to keep the current value. Leave both password fields empty to keep the current password. Saving syncs both config.yml and .env.
ports_help: Ports are collected only when this page is opened or refreshed. Only remarks and hidden state are editable and saved to ports.yaml. Docker scans the container network by default; mount the host /proc and set FLARE_PORT_PROC_ROOT to scan host ports.
ports_load_failed: Failed to load ports. The table is still editable with loaded data.
ports_all_hidden: All ports in the current table are marked hidden.
ports_all_unhidden: All ports in the current table are unhidden.
